_doc: Where a character is from — the doorstep a run starts on, and the place they are found standing when somebody else is the lead. site_kind is resolved against the generated world by WorldGen.starting_cell_for_hero.

_schema.display_name: Shown on the reveal and party screens.
_schema.blurb: One line. What kind of place it is.
_schema.text: The authored history, a short paragraph.
_schema.site_kind: village | keep | library | hut | gate | tower — which generated site this hearth lands on.
_schema.area: Optional hand-built area id from data/areas/ where this character stands as an NPC.

village_hearth.blurb: Forty people, one well, and a bell that has rung for worse than this.
village_hearth.text: Somewhere with a name nobody outside the valley has heard, where the road widens for two hundred paces and then remembers itself.

keep_hearth.blurb: Cold stone, a garrison that is mostly household, and a view of the road for a day in each direction.
keep_hearth.text: Built by somebody who expected trouble from one direction and got it from another. Still standing, which is the only argument it needs.

cloister_hearth.blurb: Copied pages, cold floors, and the only fire that is kept lit all winter.
cloister_hearth.text: A house of readers on a hillside, holding knowledge that fades if nobody uses it, which is most of it, most years.

wild_hearth.blurb: One roof, a long way from the next one.
wild_hearth.text: Out past where the road stops being maintained. Whoever built it wanted to see anyone coming.

gate_mouth.blurb: Nobody is from here. Some people end up here anyway.
gate_mouth.text: The ground goes wrong about a hundred paces out, and the people who sleep within sight of it have their reasons and do not share them.
